definitions.gloss: front line; battle front; war front
definitions.explanation: The area where opposing military forces engage in combat. Also used figuratively for the front line of any competitive or challenging endeavor.

examples.japanese: {戦線|せんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{負傷|ふしょう}して→負傷する：28056_fushousuru⟧{戦線|せんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
examples.english: He was wounded and left the front.

notes:
Literally 'battle line,' used both for military fronts and figuratively for the leading edge of competition, effort, or activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦線|せんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離脱|りだつ}→離脱：14583_ridatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to withdraw from the front
- {戦線|せんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{膠着|こうちゃく}→膠着：13935_kouchaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the front becomes deadlocked
- {戦線|せんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to expand the front
- ⟦{統一|とういつ}→統一：04551_touitsu⟧{戦線|せんせん}: united front

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧: front line — used both militarily and in weather ({梅雨|ばいう}⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧ 'rainy season front'); broader usage than {戦線|せんせん}
- ⟦{最前線|さいぜんせん}→最前線：13057_saizensen⟧: the very front line — the most forward position; also used figuratively for cutting-edge work
- ⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧: battlefield — the physical location of a battle rather than the line of engagement

RELATED WORDS:
- {戦線|せんせん}⟦{復帰|ふっき}→復帰：12564_fukki⟧: return to the front; comeback (often used in sports for returning from injury)
